UTEP IEEE RAS / PROJECT 02

Garage Occupancy Sensor

Real-time garage status, sent to Discord.

A presence-sensing system that lets members check whether the robotics garage is occupied through Discord notifications.

Status
Built
Application
Garage availability

Focus

  • ESP32
  • Human-presence sensor
  • SolidWorks
  • Bambu Lab
  • Discord

Design

A human-presence sensor detects occupancy, and an ESP32-based system posts status notifications to Discord so members can check garage availability.

Development

The enclosure was designed in SolidWorks and 3D-printed on a Bambu Lab printer to house the ESP32 and presence sensor.
